domain: conceptual ontology and taxonomy design, organizational learning and knowledge transfer, and naming/mnemonic craft
axioms: A concept is distinct only if practitioners given one-line definitions sort real cases the same way; if the surrounding prose must adjudicate, the joint has not been carved.
Conditional, non-mandatory invocation is strong evidence of a capability or side-loop rather than a lifecycle phase.
Constraining the candidate search to one initial letter is a search-space distortion, and any operation renamed or dropped to fit the acronym is a disclosed cost.
Organizational learning research treats knowledge transfer as a capability exercised inside existing stages; promoting it to a named stage requires local evidence that overrides that default.
A term that cannot be spoken mid-cycle, written as a log verb, and turned into an artifact noun will not survive daily use.
Near-synonyms with identical input/output contracts are one candidate, and scoring them separately manufactures false diversity.
Adding a letter to a model is a permanent taxonomy cost paid by every future reader, not a one-time design decision.
primitives: concept definition and its boundary cases
category verdict: phase / side-loop / capability / artifact type
semantic overlap with Observe, Orient, Reflect, Compound
term: verb-shape, imperative form, artifact noun, abbreviation
failure_mode: Can talk itself out of every candidate on parsimony grounds and miss a genuinely novel operation that happens to be adjacent to an existing one.
Over-indexes on definitional tidiness and naming taste while ignoring whether the mechanism actually improves learning or transfer in practice.
Blind to runtime behavior: says nothing about triggers, cadence, stability, or what happens when the operation fires a thousand times.
Ignores governance — a well-named, well-carved operation can still create a competing truth channel and this lens will not see it.
Risks importing organizational-learning findings from human institutions into an agent runtime without checking that the transfer holds.
